profile.campus: Digital Realty Dallas-Fort Worth (Richardson Telecom Corridor / Dallas County), TX
profile.reading:
This is Digital Realty facility DFW16, at 1232 Alma Road, Richardson, TX 75081. Digital Realty's own property listing for DFW16, fetched this session, lists the building at 106,500 square feet.

Digital Realty Trust (NYSE: DLR, SEC CIK 1297996), headquartered at 2323 Bryan Street, Dallas, Texas, reported 310 data centers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, 221 wholly owned or consolidated and 89 in unconsolidated joint ventures, about 57.6 million rentable square feet across more than 55 metro markets including 118 US facilities, per its FY2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC. The company operates as a colocation and wholesale landlord rather than running its own compute, distinguishing it from hyperscaler tenants such as AWS, Google, or Meta, also tracked in this registry.

This building is part of Digital Realty's Dallas-Fort Worth metro portfolio, concentrated in Richardson's Telecom Corridor along East Collins Boulevard, Alma Road, Security Row, and Quality Way, with additional sites elsewhere in Dallas County. Digital Realty's own Dallas metro page, fetched this session, lists numerous named properties across this footprint. Dallas-Fort Worth is one of the largest data center markets in the US, also hosting large AWS, CyrusOne, and QTS campuses tracked elsewhere in this registry; Oncor Electric Delivery is the principal utility serving most of the metro and has flagged large-load data center interconnection requests as a fast-growing category on its system. The company does not publish a consolidated IT power rating in megawatts for individual Dallas-area buildings in the sources reviewed this session.

Digital Realty markets its Dallas properties under its PlatformDIGITAL brand, positioning the metro alongside Northern Virginia, Chicago, Silicon Valley, and New York/New Jersey, all tracked elsewhere in this registry, as core hubs in its global interconnection and colocation platform.

reading.body:
Digital Realty DFW16 is a 106,500 square foot colocation building in Richardson, Texas, at 1232 Alma Road in Dallas County's Telecom Corridor. Digital Realty does not publish an IT power rating for this facility, either on its property listing or in its SEC filings, which report only aggregate square footage and facility counts by region rather than per-building capacity.

The building sits in Dallas-Fort Worth, one of the largest data center markets in the United States, where Oncor Electric Delivery has reported rapidly growing large-load interconnection requests from data centers as a significant trend on its system. Texas state lawmakers and ERCOT have responded with new large-load interconnection rules, and DFW municipalities have used Chapter 380 and 381 economic development agreements to attract investment. Digital Realty's Dallas metro portfolio clusters in Richardson's Telecom Corridor alongside independent large campuses operated by CyrusOne, QTS, and AWS, all tracked separately in this registry.

Without a published megawatt figure, this facility cannot be ranked by compute density or tied to a specific share of the state's disclosed capacity. Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities of which only 18 publish power ratings totaling 468 megawatts. This building is one of a large unmeasured pool whose contribution to AI infrastructure growth in the state remains opaque at the source level.
